papers.title: Prediction of Slurry Erosion–Corrosion in SLM-Produced Ti-6Al-4V Using ANFIS Modeling: Influence of Impact Angles and Erodent Mass
papers.abstract: Understanding erosion–corrosion mechanisms in selective laser-melted (SLM) Ti-6Al-4V is essential for optimizing component durability in demanding sectors such as oil and gas, hydropower, and offshore engineering, where slurry-induced degradation prevails. Nevertheless, it is challenging to experimentally evaluate slurry erosion–corrosion over a wide range of SLM processing parameters and various slurry erosion–corrosion operating conditions. The adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) offers a robust computational approach for modeling complex systems with independent variables, making it well suited for this investigation. This study aims to assess the efficacy of ANFIS in predicting the mass loss of as-built SLM-processed Ti-6Al-4V under slurry erosion–corrosion conditions, with a focus on the synergistic effects of impact angle and erodent mass in both saline and pure water environments, validated against empirical data. The quantitative analysis reveals that erodent mass is the dominant factor influencing mass loss, followed by impact angles. Notably, the combined effect of erodent mass and impact angles in saline environments (e.g., sea water) exacerbates material loss by approximately 16% compared to pure water, highlighting the critical role of electrochemical corrosion in synergy with mechanical erosion. The results demonstrate that the ANFIS model accurately simulates the degradation behavior of SLM-processed Ti-6Al-4V subjected to water–silica slurry impacts within the experimental parameter space; however, predictive generalization beyond these conditions should be interpreted carefully due to validation constraint.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了激光选区熔化Ti-6Al-4V的泥浆冲蚀腐蚀行为，属于AM Ti-6Al-4V的广义性能，但与层1重点关注的力学与疲劳性能不直接相关。
llm.why_not_core: Does not address mechanical or fatigue properties; focuses on erosion-corrosion mass loss prediction.

summary_zh.motivation: 预测SLM Ti-6Al-4V在泥浆环境中的冲蚀腐蚀行为，以优化部件耐久性。
summary_zh.method: 采用ANFIS模型，以冲击角度和磨料质量为输入，在盐水与纯水中验证。
summary_zh.result: 磨料质量是主导因素，盐水环境使质量损失增加约16%，ANFIS在实验范围内准确模拟。
summary_zh.validation: 基于实验数据进行验证，实验包括不同冲击角度和磨料质量的泥浆冲蚀测试。

summary_en.motivation: Predicting slurry erosion-corrosion behavior of SLM Ti-6Al-4V to optimize component durability in aggressive environments.
summary_en.method: An ANFIS model was developed using impact angle and erodent mass as inputs, validated with experimental data in saline and pure water.
summary_en.result: Erodent mass is the dominant factor; saline environments increase mass loss by ~16%; the ANFIS model accurately simulates within the tested conditions.
summary_en.validation: Validation against experimental slurry erosion tests with varying impact angles and erodent masses.

papers.title: Enhancement of surface quality in powder bed fusion using a laser beam by flat-top laser beam profile control
papers.abstract: A powder bed fusion using a laser beam process incorporating a flat-top beam was developed to improve the fabrication quality of Ti–6Al–4V (Ti64). To evaluate the influence of the fabricated structures, the denudation zone (DZ) was measured as a key indicator through single-bead and single-layer fabrication experiments. The main objective was to clarify the correlation between DZ formation and ambient pressure under flat-top beam irradiation, with reduced-pressure conditions introduced primarily to understand the underlying physical mechanisms. In this study, Ti64 powder was irradiated by a flat-top beam at output powers of 150–250 W and scanning speeds of 80–180 mm/s. It was found that decreasing the ambient pressure from 105 to 103 Pa reduced the DZ width, whereas further reduction to 102 Pa caused the DZ to expand. The minimum DZ width of 100.5 μm was obtained at 103 Pa.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及Ti-6Al-4V的增材制造表面质量优化，但未提供任何力学或疲劳性能数据，因此对L1层直接参考价值有限。
llm.why_not_core: No mechanical or fatigue testing was performed; the study focuses solely on surface quality via denudation zone measurement without any tensile, fatigue, or hardness data.

summary_zh.motivation: 利用平顶光束提高Ti-6Al-4V激光粉末床熔融的表面质量。
summary_zh.method: 通过单道和单层实验，测量不同功率、扫描速度和气压下的剥离区宽度。
summary_zh.result: 气压降至10^3 Pa时剥离区最窄（100.5 μm），进一步降低则扩大。
summary_zh.validation: 基于单道和单层实验的剥离区宽度测量。

summary_en.motivation: To enhance surface quality in laser powder bed fusion of Ti-6Al-4V by employing a flat-top laser beam profile.
summary_en.method: Single-bead and single-layer fabrication experiments were conducted with a flat-top beam at powers of 150–250 W and scanning speeds of 80–180 mm/s, and the denudation zone width was measured as a function of ambient pressure.
summary_en.result: Decreasing ambient pressure from 10^5 to 10^3 Pa reduced the denudation zone width, with a minimum of 100.5 μm at 10^3 Pa; further reduction to 10^2 Pa caused expansion.
summary_en.validation: The denudation zone width was experimentally quantified using single-bead and single-layer builds.
